text:
Harper (Finance): Heads up: our daily billing audit found 57 Stripe payments marked as succeeded but our reporting job shows no NetSuite invoices. Saw it at 13:12 UTC. Can payments/infra triage?

Dmitri (Payments): Looking at Stripe logs now. Any webhook delivery spikes or retries?

netbot: ALERT: webhook-delivery anomalies detected for /webhooks/netsuite 13:00:10 - 13:22:45 UTC. Failed events: 57. Error mix: 29 x SignatureVerificationError, 20 x UpstreamHTTP(429), 8 x UpstreamHTTP(500). See /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742755555

Yara (Backend): Quick summary from initial logs: we rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET at 12:50 during maintenance. Also, our billing-sync retry backoff was recently changed to a tighter aggressive policy to reduce lag — looks like we hit NetSuite rate limits (429) and retried immediately which produced partial create attempts.

Len (Ops): I rolled the previous secret back into the billing-sync env as fallback at 13:05 and restarted the service. Monitoring inbound webhook failures now.

Dmitri (Payments): Example Stripe event: evt_7ZxQ1 - invoice.payment_succeeded, metadata.invoice_ref="INV-2026-05-01-501". I queued the event to the backfill list.

Yara (Backend): Important note: our idempotency behavior depends on a custom header x-rwd-invoice-id we generate for creates. The recent backoff change removed a critical guard that set idempotency header on every retry. So when NetSuite returned 429 then later 500, retries generated new create attempts without idempotency header -> partial records + duplicate attempts.

Harper (Finance): Oof. That explains the dupes we saw in the reconciler where there are orphaned NS records with no PDF and an "incomplete" flag. Customers are asking for invoices. Need an action plan and CSV for CS.

Yara (Backend): Short-term fix: re-enable idempotency header for all retries and change retry backoff to exponential with jitter. Also add a safety-clamp: if NetSuite returns 429 or 500 after a partial response, pause retries for that external_id for 30 minutes. Pushing hotfix now.

netbot: DEPLOYMENT: billing-sync v2.21.0-hotfix deployed by Yara at 13:28 UTC. Health checks passing.

Len (Ops): Opening NetSuite case NS-10440: flagged partial-create traces and suspected duplicate attempts due to missing idempotency header. Requesting NetSuite clear orphan partial records and advise on safe re-run.

Dmitri (Payments): Before backfill, I'll export exceptions CSV (stripe_event, external_invoice_ref, customer_email, amount, currency, stripe_status, stripe_event_id). CS wants it in the next 20m.

Yara (Backend): Generating recon CSV and dedupe set now. Saved to /finance/recon/ops/1742755555-missing_invoices.csv. Backfill plan: 1) dedupe by stripe_event_id and external_invoice_ref, 2) for each record check if NetSuite has an "incomplete" record via external_ref lookup, 3) if incomplete -> PATCH to complete instead of CREATE, 4) if no record -> CREATE with idempotency header, 5) on 429/500 -> mark for manual review instead of blind retry.

netbot: JOB: recon-backfill queued (job_id=rb-1742755555-1).

Len (Ops): NetSuite replied to NS-10440: they can clear 11 orphan partial records and will add a lock on external_ref keys for 1 hour while we re-run. ETA 90-120 minutes.

Harper (Finance): How many customers affected and any charge duplication risk?

Dmitri (Payments): 57 events total, 55 unique customers, no duplicate charges detected in Stripe. Risk is missing invoice records and orphan partials in NS. Backfill will fill or complete records where safe.

Yara (Backend): Starting backfill run in 40m after NetSuite confirms cleanup. I'm also adding an audit log entry for each inbound webhook that records the stripe-signature header and our verification decision to help debug future rotations.

Dmitri (Payments): Backfill started at 14:05 UTC (manual trigger). Posting progress here.

netbot: BACKFILL-PROGRESS: processed=57, created=46, patched_incomplete=11, flagged_manual=0. CSV: /finance/recon/ops/1742755555-missing_invoices.csv

Len (Ops): NetSuite cleared the 11 orphan partials at 14:01 UTC per NS-10440. Good coordination.

Harper (Finance): Excellent. CS has the CSV and will reach out to the handful of customers whose PDFs were delayed. Please include a short postmortem with root cause (secret rotation + removed idempotency header on retries + aggressive retry policy hitting 429s), remediation (re-enable idempotency header, exponential backoff + jitter, pause-on-partial), and follow-ups (automated Stripe secret sync, alert on 429 spikes, add integration test exercising partial-create flows).

Yara (Backend): Will draft postmortem. Immediate PRs: 1) re-add idempotency header on retries, 2) exponential backoff with jitter, 3) pause-on-partial for external_id, 4) audit logging of stripe-signature and verifier decision. ETA postmortem draft: EOD.

Dmitri (Payments): Sent exceptions CSV to CS and flagged the 11 patched records for manual audit. No refunds required.

Len (Ops): Added alert rule: if NetSuite 429s > 5 in 3m or webhook.signature.failures > 8 in 5m, auto-notify #eng-oncall and #finance. Also added pre-rotation runbook step to push updated signing secret to Stripe via API and keep previous secret for 24h.

Harper (Finance): Thanks everyone. I'll close reconciliation once CS confirms customers received invoices. Please post the postmortem here when ready. :thumbsup:
